title: CLIO model overlay entry
description: One model/family entry in the manual model overlay (model-capabilities brief Part 8). Each catalogs/models/<family>.yaml file is a LIST of these entries, one per model family or size variant. The shape is clio-coder's own knowledge-base entry format, adopted as-is (brief Part 8.4) so a later move to a folder shared with clio-coder is a copy, not a migration -- fields clio-coder records that clio-agent does not yet read (gpuTiers, runtimePreference, llamaCpp, kvCache, chatTemplate, serving, leakageNote, thinkingControl, ...) are still accepted verbatim (additionalProperties) rather than rejected.

family.description: The family name. Also the file's own basename (catalogs/models/<family>.yaml) by convention.

matchPatterns.description: Substrings matched case-insensitively against a wire/model id. Longest match across every loaded entry wins (brief Part 8.2/8.4); ties are broken by which overlay root loaded last (brief Part 8.6).

quirks.description: Engine-visible quirks (model-catalog.md: 'Engine-visible quirks belong in quirks.kvCache, quirks.sampling, and quirks.thinking'). Only sampling/thinking/measuredUnder are validated in depth (brief Part 8.4); every other clio-coder quirk key (gpuTiers, runtimePreference, llamaCpp, kvCache, chatTemplate, serving, leakageNote, thinkingControl, ...) rides through verbatim.

measuredUnder.description: Provenance for the quirks above: what was actually measured and under which runtime (brief Part 8.4). Never deployment data -- see brief Part 8.4 last paragraph.

samplingProfile.description: A flat map of numeric sampling fields (temperature, topP, topK, minP, presencePenalty, repetitionPenalty, maxTokens, reasoningBudget, ...); the exact field set varies by family.
